answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 7260 Country: India Title: Presently i m working with multinational bank in dubai in sales departmentamy job involves selling of credit cards and banking products.my question is the money i m making ofut of my job is it halaal? Question: Presently i m working with multinational bank in dubai in sales departmentamy job involves selling of credit cards and banking products.my question is the money i m making ofut of my job is it halaal? Answer ID: 7260 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1506/1422=D/1429) If the banking products include no haram things then it is permissible for you to work in the sales department and the earned salary shall be lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
